title: Decision context
description: Supporting record for traces. A server-issued id grouping everything a worker read while making one decision. Server-issued, not a time window: one principal may run two tasks on the same matter at once. Append-only like everything else.

id.description: Server-issued context id, e.g. 'C-77', returned by state.begin_decision.

principal.description: The worker or person whose reads are being grouped.

run.description: The worker's run identifier — two concurrent tasks on one matter get two contexts.

closedByTrace.description: The trace that consumed this context. Set once by the server; a context with no trace records a decision that was never made.

receipts.description: Every receipt issued under this context, in issue order — attached in full to the trace (§4 of the README).
